title: British Raj (1858-1947)
key_facts: British colonial rule over Indian subcontinent
Crown rule after 1858 Government of India Act
Included present-day India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Myanmar
World's largest colonial administration with 300+ million subjects
causes: British East India Company's expansion and military victories
Decline of Mughal and Maratha power creating vacuum
Strategic importance of Indian resources and markets
outcome: Partition of India into Hindu and Muslim nations
Independence and creation of India and Pakistan
Mass migration and violence during partition
Established English language and legal systems in region
impacts: Created modern nation-states of India and Pakistan
Left legacy of English language and legal systems
Caused massive displacement and trauma from partition violence
